chapters.summary: Lucia talks to a prison counselor about her arrest and her chances of early release. A flashback then shows the payday loan robbery that put her there.

Jason works for Brian in the Keys with Cal and Donnie: smuggling runs, collecting rent, a dive trip for Kenton. Lucia is released early, the two set up home and open a bank account, and then Mattia's "simple job" ends in trouble at Vice City Hospital.
chapters.goal: Settle in the Keys, get Lucia home and survive the hospital job.
side: Kirk and the Skunk Ape, at night only
Shirley's two missions, gone once Tourist Trap starts

opens.text: Taxi fast travel works after Gone Fishing: call the taxi, set a marker on the map and pay $100 to skip the ride.
Money you earn in Chapter 1 is lost when the chapter ends, so do not farm it. Just follow the story.
The one possibly missable trophy item: after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's morning meditation on the balcony. Unclear if it counts for Positive Mental Attitude, so do it.

chapters.summary: A motel in Port Gellhorn. Lucia runs things while Jason recovers: she pays the motel bill, hunts for painkillers, gets a car from Moses and a new look. Then the two start pulling stick-ups together and need $15,000 to move to Vice City.
chapters.goal: Earn $15,000 and move to Vice City.
side: Kyle, Moses, Bret Vogel and Billy start here

opens.text: After Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia in the open world.
Moses unlocks: you can sell him stolen cars without trackers, and the Scooter Bros app arrives.
The RydeMe app replaces the taxi for fast travel.
Prepare for Vice City only starts once you have at least $15,000 saved and the other pending Chapter 2 missions are done.

chapters.summary: Vice City. Dre'Quan, Boobie and Lucia's mother Mia help them settle while Jason picks up work from Tyrone. They meet Raul and his crew, run jobs for him, and spend the second half preparing the Cartel Heist at Sinfrontera National Bank.
side: Yago's races, Andy, Yasmani, Randy, Tyrone and Dunk start here

opens.text: Credit Check unlocks bank jobs and the Dye Pack Jammer you need to fence marked bills.
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs open jewelry store robberies, which pay $10,000 to $25,000 each.
Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS unlocks the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List of high-end cars.
You receive $120,000 automatically at the end of the chapter.

chapters.summary: Ocean Beach. A new base, a lawyer called Abe Gonzalez and a string of jobs. The long VCIA Takedown builds up an airport heist, with Lucia working with Nate and Kordell and Jason scouting the airport. Jason also chases blackmail material, and a kidnapping involving Rafa pulls them in. It closes with Sunset and Starting From Zero.
chapters.goal: Pull off the airport heist and deal with what it leaves behind.
unlocks: Large bank vaults, the fastest money
side: Eddie Acosta and Pilot Pete start here

opens.text: The optional mission That's Where the Money Is... unlocks large bank vault robberies, the fastest money in the game. Doing it is effectively the point of no return before the ending.

chapters.summary: The final stretch: boost a car, a new plan, a favour for Mattia, a contraband hunt with Vinny and the Operation Savage Glory shipment, then more dealings with Abe. It ends with The End of the Road.

opens.text: The last chapter. After the story you go back to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist becomes visible under Progress > Stats.

discrepancies: Story length: GTABase says about 50 to 80 hours, PowerPyx says 60 to 80.

Mission count: GTABase lists 122 story entries (119 main missions plus a few short story tasks); other outlets count around 91 to 93 main missions. This guide numbers the 119 main missions in GTABase order. Missions can show up in a slightly different order in your game.

Last chapter: the PowerPyx roadmap says both Top Of The World, Ma and You Gotta Know When to Get Off unlock with Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, but its own walkthrough (and GTABase) has a Chapter 5 that ends with The End of the Road. The trophy list says Complete Chapter 4 and Complete the final mission, so this guide ties the second one to the last mission of Chapter 5.
